adopted_rules: complete product centred in a horizontal band
labels outside the product silhouette, rows above/below
orthogonal elbow leaders ending on the part
thin leader lines with dot endpoints
short bold label title + one supporting line

excluded_elements: circular magnifier (not used: no higher-res source of same part)

tokens.palette_note: accent is a demo token chosen to echo the demo product; brand accent must come from the job (brand_input_required)

strokes.port: r5 accent dot 22px off the first title line

label_width.max: min(500, 0.38W), used when it saves a title line

elements.text: Opening at the nose; blade shown retracted
Ridged thumb slider on the upper body
Dark button set into the nose section
Through-hole at the rear of the grip

adaptation_rules: frames: light (8px accent strip, white sweeping into #DCDDDE; the floor starts at the product's base footprint with a soft 0.11H gradient, contact shadow is an ellipse laid along the base's front edge), band (dark header 200, 232 with a badge, + 14px accent rule + 72px footer with disclaimer; header holds job.badge plus the headline right-aligned in 1-2 lines (60->40px) if it fits, or the headline alone), plain (studio radial ground)
anchor marker: one style for every anchor, an open accent square (half-size 19, white halo) framing the part so small parts (rivets) stay visible; the drawn line stops at the square's edge
vertical placement prefers the product top ~60px under the headline (no dead band), lower spots are tried after; size steps 1..0.6 in 0.05

callout_style numbered/column: one column on label_side as wide as its widest label (disc 48px or 6px accent bar, then the text), evenly spaced (gap 40..88 numbered, 40..260 column); the product is fitted beside it (48px gap numbered, 120px column) and centred in the room under the headline. numbered: discs (r24, white ring) sit on the anchors, numbered top to bottom; discs closer than 54px, or touching the headline or legend, are refused. column: labels in the parts' top-to-bottom order, a swap allowed at a price when it keeps a line off the product; leaders as the preset routes them, no crossings, 31px clear of other squares, no kinks under 72px, runs skimming the outline penalised. Too crowded at every size: a qa note and a forced layout whose collisions fail QA, so lay_out takes the next job

labels may sit beside the headline when clear of its ink box by 64/56px; label column 420 (min(420,0.35W)), widened to min(500,0.38W) when that saves a title line; hyphenated compounds in en bodies use a non-breaking hyphen
zh: a clause mark at a headline line break is dropped; a short headline (<=6 chars/line) is set at 120px

hero keyed off its white backdrop with an SVG luminance key (job.hero_key, default on except band) so the split ground passes behind the product without tinting it; multiply blend only when the key is off
headline notch top-left: eyebrow + h1 88px (72px compact step), max 2 lines; a written two-line headline without markup is two-tone (first line accent; job.two_tone=false turns it off)
labels in the side margins, flush to m (left ragged-right, right ragged-left), width <= min(400, 0.3W), >= 60px vertical gap; title 44 display 800 uppercase, optional body 30 Inter 500 at 72% ink
leaders: horizontal from a port 22px off the first title line then one elbow to the anchor, or a vertical port above/below the label; short hooks (<72px vertical) penalised

size search: the largest product (100% down to 60% of target) whose leaders are all <= job.leader_max*W (default 0.45) and run over <= 42% of the product width; otherwise the largest collision-free layout is kept and noted
job.label_body 'auto' (default): if the product would drop below 86% with bodies, titles-only is tried and kept when it gives a larger product
detail insets: features with detail_asset get a circle inset (r 140 @1500, 124 below) above the title, max 2
max 4 labels; more -> split image (no font shrinking)
zh: Noto Sans SC, no uppercase, author line breaks kept
limitations: demo_only: all photos are third-party reference images with unverified rights; original branding kept, not replaced
all copy is neutral visual description, not approved product claims
elements above are the measured layout of the main render; real layout is computed by the template rules for each job
rendered by engine/render.py with Chrome --headless=old (no visible window); SVG/PDF not produced (no verified vector path)
numbers in feature copy are not checked against the render (e.g. "4 rivets" vs one visible rivet per tab); the set builder must keep copy true to the image

optional_job_fields.badge_headline: bool, default true: in band with a badge, also set the headline in the band if it fits
optional_job_fields.floor_sweep: floor gradient height in px, default 0.11*H
optional_job_fields.callout_style: 'leaders' (default: labels in the margins) | 'numbered' (numbered accent discs on the parts + a numbered legend column, title and body, in reading order) | 'column' (every label stacked in one column, accent bar at its left edge, level or one-bend leaders)
optional_job_fields.label_side: 'left'|'right', default 'right': the side of the numbered legend / label column; the product takes the other side
